scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build:database: npm run prisma:generate --workspace=@storagepk/database && npm run build --workspace=@storagepk/database
scripts.release:desktop: node tools/check-desktop-oauth.mjs && npm run tauri:test --workspace=@storagepk/desktop && npm run tauri:build --workspace=@storagepk/desktop && node tools/release-check.mjs --desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:providers && npm run build:database && npm run build:api && npm run build:worker && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run release:prepare && npm run typecheck:workspaces
scripts.lint: npm run release:prepare && npm run lint:workspaces
scripts.release:prepare: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:providers && npm run build:database
scripts.release: npm run security:scan && npm run release:prepare && npm run lint:workspaces && npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm test && npm run build && npm run release:check
